Vilnius' placeholder is [[a brigand]] or [[a bandit]] on the top of the mountain. The brigand, as well as all the bandits, are on the KaranaBandits faction, but Vilnius is indifferent to all.

However, Vilnius is not there all the time; he has a placeholder (the aforementioned brigand) who despawns at 7 p.m. game time (the very verge of 8 p.m., before the clock ticks over) each day. Once the brigand despawns, Vilnius will spawn very shortly after and will despawn at 5 a.m. game time. If the brigand is up, don't kill it, just wait until it despawns. If you do kill him, Vilnius won't spawn, and you'll have to wait until the brigand spawns again. This time, let the brigand despawn, and then Vilnius will spawn a little later.

'''Vilnius spawns around 8pm and despawns at 5am'''

 Vilnius the Small says, 'Okayge, just because I am short don't mean I can't bounce your Iksar rump all over these hills.
 Now, do you have something for me, or are you just in search of a rump bouncing?'
 You say, 'I'm in search of a rump bouncing'
 Vilinus the Small says, 'My pleasure to oblige you then. Shall I start on the left side or the right side?'

He will become hostile and attack you if you say that. Props for sticking to his word, I suppose. Ouch!
